comments.value: This would be great for not having to make a separate save system on the avatar to save all your presets you have to save slots! <3  They take agers to set up, and if you accidently reset the avatar, BOOm, all save slots erased-

Having this be a seperate paramiter Check box on the Paramiters menu would be best!

This would stop players from breaking avatars that perhaps have systems or animations on them that "use up" a toggle or animation, else players could just reset it back to when they had it.

So having this be an extra check box here would be great and allow better control for avatar creator's avatars!

This 100% this. Tons of people love to customize their avatars, and switch between looks. A way to make switching between configurations on the fly easier would be great. Though as other's have said, This should be an additional setting per parameter in the parameters file in the SDK as to prevent breaking certain other aspects of the avatar.

@{62def591a3b0fa44be058bab|full_name}, Having it just save all parameters that are "Saved" would likely be fine. Since those are usually the ones that matter?

I guess there will be weird exceptions, such as that weird "knife loot box" avatar prefab I have seen a few times. But those are more the exception than the rule, so something along the lines of a "Save independently of looks" options would likely be nice to have for that. But it would still be a disruptive SDK change no matter how it is implemented.
God, how long I have been waiting for this. 1000 upvotes if I could.
Thanks for the feedback. This is consideration for future iteration and improvements, but we don't have plans to add this right now.
Honestly was surprised this wasn't the default, on top of accessories, being able to save different "snapshots" of your avi to your action menu would be dope

This was absolutely my FIRST thought as soon as I started messing with looks. Im sure it wouldnt take a huge amount of time to implement, I have a couple of different things i'd love to pack into looks even with my own custom uploads. Sometimes I have two different ways i'd like an avatar to look built into the avatar but like several different menus to achieve it. It would be so nice to have it just be one button. I do love the looks also doubling as a quick swap for avis too.

@{62def591a3b0fa44be058bab|full_name} Yeah I agree with the other guy, not so sure that this would be best? The thing is that would require an update to the SDK which is a whole other can of worms. I think the feature request here would ideally have no effect on the SDK.

@{62845dc19646c60b7bdbb3d0|full_name}

It would be good not just for not breaking an avatar, but also something that perhaps doesnt relate to looks. say avatars have accessibility features, or performance toggles that have save checked, meaning all those would also be saved with your "look".

As annoying as it only working on new avatars having to update the SDK to have an extra box, it means it would not both get in the way, or break avatars, which for any big update is something VRChat wants to avoid asap.

It's not too big of a change, and VRChat often updates the SDK every couple months or so, even adding new stuff to the Toon Standered shaider last patch ^o^   

I have avatars with my own save systems I've implemented onto them, and half the toggles would be VERY annoying if they saved with the save system, so I make sure to not put those toggles (That have "saved" checked on in parameters still). But since Looks would act in a way like an avatar load out save system, again having a lot of general prop and such toggles save with your "look" would get in the way, again allong with breaking a lotta avatars and prefabs due to how they design the backend to work with peramiter drivers and save checked on / off.

Hey, I know this feedback request is probably looked at as a niche "nice to have"/low priority feature, but I'd like to bring more attention to this request as it absolutely could be huge for reducing animator load and/or alleviate users needing background OSC apps to accomplish custom toggle presets. It would also bring even more attention to VRC Accessories since that's what Looks are centered around!

Currently, a common way avatar creators create these "custom save presets" is by using hundreds of Parameter Drivers in the animator to copy and load the desired params.

As an example, here's one of my private avatar IDs that has this tech: avtr_db31f76f-cf49-4acd-abfd-7e9a16e7e034

Also here's a rough example screenshot of the UI where this checkbox could be opt-in when creating the avatar Look.

details:
Since we now have a looks system for saving presets for avatar accessories, it would be an excellent opportunity to extend this feature to cover the much-requested feature of saving avatar parameter presets. 

As an example: Editing a look should show the avatar in it current state (instead of the default as it does now) or perhaps there should be a button to sync the state to match how it is in game. Saving the look should save all saved parameters to the look. And loading a look should restore all saved parameters to those saved values, along with the attached accessories. 

This would also solve the issue of default-disabled transforms not showing up in the looks editor.

This would be a big boon especially to marketplace avatars, who currently have to implement complex animator systems to provide save slots.
title: [1814] Looks should save current avatar parameters
